items.summary: Vertex Pharmaceuticals has re-upped its ties with sequencing specialist Genomics in a deal worth up to $220 million, signing on for an extra four years on top of the eight the companies have already worked together.

items.title: Priavoid’s Alzheimer’s pill fails to prove efficacy in phase 2 trial
items.summary: Priavoid’s pill for Alzheimer's disease has failed to prove its effectiveness in a phase 2 dementia study, although the German biotech pointed to encouraging signs in the longer-term data.

items.title: FDA clears MiniMed Fit tubeless insulin pump
items.summary: MiniMed announced has picked up FDA clearance of its tubeless insulin pump, the MiniMed Fit.

items.title: Cognito phase 3 flops in light-and-sound Alzheimer's trial, but sees ‘signal’ for HOPE
items.summary: Cognito Therapeutics said its phase 3 HOPE study of Spectris AD, an investigational, non-invasive, at-home Alzheimer's therapy that uses light and sound stimulation to engage brain activity, failed to meet its primary endpoint.

items.title: Regulatory tracker: Novo's Sogroya wins 4th label expansion this year
items.summary: In this tracker, Fierce Pharma is recording the regulatory progress of in-market products, including expansions into key geographies and new indications. Some of these updates may not meet the bar for standalone stories, but we think they are still worth mentioning.

items.title: Mapping psychedelics’ commercial summit
items.summary: Several years after the FDA's high-profile rejection of Lykos Therapeutics’ MDMA candidate for post-traumatic stress disorder, a new wave of developers is nearing the regulatory finish line with experimental psychedelic treatments for mental health conditions. But regulatory approval is, in many ways, just the beginning of a complex journey to market for these companies, should their drugs pass mu…

items.title: Another 215 layoffs linked to Novo's New Jersey HQ
items.summary: Novo will trim 215 jobs reporting to its New Jersey headquarters starting in February as part of a "redesign" of its U.S. sales organization.

items.title: FDA sets up new safety council to keep tabs on approved vaccines, cell and gene therapies
items.summary: The FDA's Center for Biologics Evaluation and Research is setting up a new governance body focused on safety oversight of products like cell and gene therapies and vaccines once they’ve hit the market.

items.title: Sanofi gets Genzyme asset across FDA finish line with key nod in Gaucher type 3
items.summary: Sanofi's Infilbray secured an FDA approval to treat children and adults with the rare metabolic and neurogenerative disorder Type 3 Gaucher disease. The daily oral therapy is the first to address the disease's neurological effects.

items.title: Biogen unblurs life with Friedreich ataxia in patient-centered Skyclarys campaign
items.summary: The company’s visual-forward campaign depicts real Friedreich ataxia patients enjoying some favorite activities while fast-moving life blurs around them, reminding prospective Skyclarys users that while “life moves fast, progression doesn’t have to.”

items.title: Facing down Dupixent cliff, Sanofi mulls buyout of Insmed and its blockbuster-to-be Brinsupri: Bloomberg
items.summary: After Sanofi leadership telegraphed an upsized appetite for business development last month, signals have emerged that the French Pharma may be eyeing a deal to acquire Insmed, the developer of new respiratory medicine Brinsupri, which appears well on its way to cementing its blockbuster status this year.

items.title: Novartis CEO, staring down $16.7B post-2030 patent cliff, challenges Wall Street consensus
items.summary: Novartis is gearing up to defend its growth trajectory against a steep wave of patent expirations in the early 2030s, as the upcoming U.S. generic entry for breast cancer blockbuster Kisqali prompted the Swiss drugmaker to trim its mid-term revenue outlook.

items.title: Arcera strikes $1B+ pact to license Innogen's approved GLP-1 outside China
items.summary: Arcera Life Sciences has agreed to potentially pay more than $1 billion to license Innogen's China-approved GLP-1 in places like Africa, Latin America and the Middle East.

items.title: Regeneron breaks into neurology with FDA nod in crowded myasthenia gravis
items.summary: Underscoring how crowded the U.S. market for generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) has become, the FDA on Wednesday approved the second targeted therapy for the neuromuscular disease this week, with the latest honor going to Regeneron and its Alnylam-licensed siRNA drug cemdisiran.

items.title: J&J draws FDA rebuke for misstating Inlexzo’s bladder-sparing benefits
items.summary: The FDA has slammed Johnson & Johnson over misleading claims about its bladder cancer drug Inlexzo, accusing the pharma company of basing statements on uninterpretable data.

items.title: CDMO Lotte inks commercial production deal as work on South Korean plant wraps
items.summary: Lotte Biologics, which was established in 2022, inked a major manufacturing deal with an unnamed pharmaceutical company as the South Korean CDMO gears up for commercial production at its new multi-billion-dollar Songdo Bio Campus near Seoul.

items.title: AI’s Real Prize: Building Tomorrow’s CI Capability
items.summary: AI is becoming a commodity. Javier Vega explains why the next advantage in competitive intelligence comes from people, judgment and scale.

items.title: BMS' ph. 3 Alzheimer's psychosis teaser builds confidence in Cobenfy expansion plan
items.summary: After delaying the phase 3 readout of its Alzheimer’s psychosis program for Cobenfy earlier this year, Bristol Myers Squibb is offering an early peek that appears to bode well for the high-stakes data drops ahead, even as the fine details remain hazy.

items.title: Beren clinches long-awaited FDA nod for cyclodextrin drug in Niemann-Pick disease
items.summary: Beren Therapeutic's Lembaz was cleared by the FDA to treat the neurogenerative disorder Niemann-Pick disease type C in children as small as 15 pounds. It's the first NPC treatment to improve survival and to treat the cholesterol transport dysfunction that drives the disease.

items.title: FDA moves to yank Salerno's liquid cholesterol drug approval on missing reports
items.summary: In a notice posted on the Federal Register Wednesday, the FDA said that it has proposed withdrawing the approval for Salerno’s FloLipid, an oral suspension formulation of the long-approved cholesterol lowering medication simvastatin.

items.title: Novo expands DTC program Novocare to support Wegovy users through holistic health journey
items.summary: Members who sign up for Novo's new Novocare can benefit from holistic health services meant to support Wegovy users throughout the entirety of their weight loss journey.
